2 . VICTIM X THROUGH P.S. VIJAYNAGAR, INDORE  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (SHRI AMIT RAVAL - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE FOR RESPONDENT  NO.1/STATE)

This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1.

This is the 2nd application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.508/2022 registered at Police Station Vijay Nagar, Indore for the offence under Section 370, 370(A), 363, 366, 376, 376(2)(n), 376(D), 377 of IPC and Section 5(L)/6, 3/4 of POCSO Act.
Applicant is in custody since 4.6.2022.

2. Applicant's earlier bail application has been dismissed on merit vide order dated 3.11.2022 passed in MCRC No.40320/2022.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant contended that applicant is innocent and she has been falsely implicated in this matter.

After rejecting her earlier application, co-accused Rahul has been enlarged Muskan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34256986/
1 on bail by the order of the Hon'ble Apex Court dated 7.5.2024 passed in Criminal Appeal No.2455/2024 in the similar circumstances.

entities.text: Rahul has been enlarged Muskan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, on the ground of parity present applicant be also enlarged on bail.
4. Per-contra, learned GA for respondent/State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection.

5. Perused the case diary as well as the impugned order of the court below.
6.

Considered all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by counsel for the parties, nature and gravity of allegation as also the fact that case of co-accused Rahul is distinguishable from the case of present applicant.

Present applicant is the main accused who initially forced the minor prosecutrix in immoral traffic business for a period of more than 6 months and she supplied the prosecutrix in different hotels and forced her for doing sex with so many customers per day.
Applicant's earlier bail application has been dismissed.
Date of birth of the prosecutrix is 18.8.2005, therefore, she was minor at the time of incident.
The offence is very heinous in nature.
7. In view of the above, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the present applicant.
Hence, this 2nd bail application is dismissed.

(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE trilok Muskan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34256986/
